tasks.label: HDL: 시뮬레이션 로그 정리
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath . -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.log', '.pb', '.jou', '.vcd', '.wdb', '.tcl'} | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName; Write-Host ('Removed: ' + $_.Name) }; $srcPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath .).Path; $simPath = Join-Path $srcPath 'xsim.dir'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $simPath) { $simDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $simPath -Force; if (!$simDir.PSIsContainer -or $simDir.Parent.FullName -ne $srcPath -or ($simDir.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { throw 'Unsafe xsim.dir path.' }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $simDir.FullName -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'Removed: xsim.dir' }

tasks.label: HDL: 시뮬레이션 및 VCD 생성
args: $vivadoBin = 'C:/AMDDesignTools/2026.1/Vivado/bin'; $sources = @(Get-ChildItem -Path *.v,*.sv -File | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName); if ($sources.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No HDL sources found.' }; & "$vivadoBin/xvlog.bat" --sv @sources; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$vivadoBin/xelab.bat" tb_top_main --debug typical --snapshot top_sim; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$vivadoBin/xsim.bat" top_sim --runall; exit $LASTEXITCODE
